sources.title: Independent softmax numeric and ordering derivation
sources.details: For [2s,s,0], p_max=exp(2s)/(exp(2s)+exp(s)+1)=1/(1+exp(-s)+exp(-2s)); candidate count=3, per-row sum=1. Reference s=1: 0.6652409557748218; s=10: 0.999954600070331. Float32 errors <1e-7; rounding to 4 decimal places gives 0.6652 and 1.0. For positive T, z_i/T > z_j/T iff z_i > z_j; exp is increasing and a shared positive denominator preserves this ordering. Labels do not occur in normalization.

claims.statement: Logits are candidate scores; softmax normalizes over candidate scores to sum one, and its maximum is not a truth check.
claims.scope: Finite fixed candidate classification; no guarantee that candidates include the true answer or that normalized scores reflect empirical correctness.

limitations.details: Historical experiment was CUDA PyTorch 2.14.1+cu126; this review is CPU PyTorch 2.14.1+cpu. Official API source inspected at pinned v2.9.0; same used contracts verified by current CPU execution. Saved logits can establish published probability arithmetic and dataset/config provenance, not reproduce training or infer broad generalization. Audio uses 16 train, 8 validation and 14 test examples grouped by frequency, with two variants per family; only four validation/seven test frequency families. Validation-selected temperature need not improve test metrics (test NLL here rises 0.277604→0.346543); section claims no such improvement. Fixed low/high probabilities do not estimate full generated answer correctness, natural speech understanding or safety-policy reliability.
